description: Compare two dembrandt extractions and return a design-drift report: a 0-100 score (0 = identical), a stable/drift verdict, per-category scores, and the list of changed/added/removed tokens (colors, typography, spacing, radius, shadows). Pure and synchronous, no browser. Takes either an inline extraction or the job_id of a completed one. Use it to check whether generated or updated UI has drifted from a brand baseline.

baseline.description: A dembrandt extraction object. Omit it and pass job_id instead to read a completed extraction straight out of the job queue, which avoids sending the whole extraction back through the model.

baselineJobId.description: job_id of a completed extraction to read instead of passing result inline

candidate.description: A dembrandt extraction object. Omit it and pass job_id instead to read a completed extraction straight out of the job queue, which avoids sending the whole extraction back through the model.

candidateJobId.description: job_id of a completed extraction to read instead of passing result inline

failThreshold.description: Score above this yields a 'drift' verdict (default 10)

name: compute_drift
